title: Photos, scrapbook and a Lions Club show
summary: DeDroit finds photographs in the scrapbook and describes a Lions Club show, the rehearsals and his commercial work.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: He was a nice fellow. He's got to play the fair. I used to finish him. If you paid him, you know. Well why not? I thought they had a picture of me in here. Boy this is old isn't it?
Yeah you'd better get that copied on a machine before it just disintegrates or something.
Oh there I am. Right in my face it tears.
Oops and it's also turned off.

Well I just want to tell you this. When I went into the commercial field, I was commercial down. I put on a show here for the Lions Club. From voodooism to the present. I rehearsed the piano, piano and drums and all that. I would bring fifteen men there to take rehearsal money when they're not even going to blow the horn. Then I'd put it all together. That's why I'd get in the building. I'd have someone in the building. I was strictly running. I played the preview for this Admiral's Sons. You know I say those things because people say, where did you play? And you can't remember. Not that I'm so proud of us. Here's a guy who was an afterwards manager. That's not bad. He's right. Mel Washburn, you ever hear of him? No I haven't.
